records.jp: お、アオちん！
records.en_original: Hey, it's Ao-Ao!
records.en: Hey, it's Ao-chin!

records.jp: どうも
records.en_original: Hi there.
records.en: Hi there.

records.jp: うーん、やっぱりユズさんの口調に違和感が……
records.en_original: ...You sound so different, Yuzu.
records.en: ...You sound so different, Yuzu-san.

records.jp: あっ！　また「さん」付けてる！
records.en_original: That's right! No more cold, emotionless Yuzu—the real Yuzu is back!
records.en: That's right! No more cold, emotionless Yuzu—the real Yuzu is back!

records.jp: ゆ、ユズ……
records.en_original: The real Yuzu...
records.en: The real Yuzu...

records.jp: よし！
records.en_original: That's right!
records.en: That's right!

records.jp: どうにも慣れないな……。<CR>ライムさんの方が前のユズっぽい
records.en_original: This will take some getting used to... Honestly, Lime acts more Yuzu-y than you do.
records.en: This will take some getting used to... Honestly, Lime-san acts more Yuzu-y than you do.

records.jp: ライムに感情がないって言いたいの？
records.en_original: Are you saying that I'm emotionless?
records.en: Are you saying Lime has no emotions?

records.jp: そういうわけでは……！
records.en_original: Th-that's not what I—!
records.en: Th-that's not what I—!

records.jp: ふふ、大丈夫。怒ってない
records.en_original: Hehe, I'm just teasing. I'm not mad.
records.en: Hehe, I'm just teasing. I'm not mad.

records.jp: さあ、記憶を取り戻した今なら<CR>いろんなことに答えられるよ！
records.en_original: Anyway, I remembered a bunch of stuff since I got my memory back!
records.en: Anyway, I remembered a bunch of stuff since I got my memory back!

records.jp: 何か聞きたいこと、ある？
records.en_original: So? Was there something you wanted to ask?
records.en: So? Was there something you wanted to ask?

records.jp: 結局雫世界は、元の世界が無くなる間際に<CR>二人が創った世界……ということでいいんだよね？
records.en_original: Oasis is a world that the two of you created right before our world was turned to nothing, right?
records.en: Oasis is a world that the two of you created right before our world was turned to nothing, right?

records.jp: うん。急いでたのもあって、無の力に耐えられずに<CR>不完全な形にはなっちゃったけど
records.en_original: Yeah. We had to hurry, and I couldn't withstand the power of nothingness, so this world ultimately remained incomplete.
records.en: Yeah. We had to hurry, and I couldn't withstand the power of nothingness, so this world ultimately remained incomplete.

records.jp: ホントはみんなこの学校に集まってるはずだったんだ。<CR>でも、バラバラになっちゃった
records.en_original: We wanted to gather everyone inside the school, but we accidentally scattered you guys all over.
records.en: We wanted to gather everyone inside the school, but we accidentally scattered you guys all over.

records.jp: ……愛央ちゃん、あなたのおかげ
records.en_original: ...Ao, we have you to thank for getting us all back together.
records.en: ...Ao-chan, we have you to thank for getting us all back together.

records.jp: あなたが来てからこの世界は動き出した。<CR>みんなの記憶や想いが声を上げた
records.en_original: You set everything here into motion. You gave a voice to everyone's memories and emotions.
records.en: You set everything here into motion. You gave a voice to everyone's memories and emotions.

records.jp: きっとアオちんにはみんなを繋ぐ力があるんだね！
records.en_original: You definitely have the power to tie us all together!
records.en: You must have the power to bring everyone together, Ao-chin!

records.jp: いやあ、私はそんな大層な人間じゃないよ。<CR>普通なことしかしてないし
records.en_original: No way, I'm not that special. Everything I did was just...normal.
records.en: No way, I'm not that special. Everything I did was just...normal.

records.jp: 普通のことを普通にやることだって、<CR>案外難しいものなんだよ。自信をもって！
records.en_original: Well, doing normal things normally is surprisingly difficult! Have a little more confidence!
records.en: Well, doing normal things normally is surprisingly difficult! Have a little more confidence!

records.jp: ……他に聞きたいことはある？
records.en_original: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en: Is there anything else you want to ask about?

records.jp: “オリジン”に想いを届けて、<CR>作り直される世界を元と同じ世界にする……
records.en_original: So we're gonna send our emotions to Origin so that the new world is the same as our former world...?
records.en: So we're gonna send our emotions to Origin so that the new world is the same as our former world...?

records.jp: 正確には、灰や原種なんてものがない元の世界、だね
records.en_original: To be more precise, we're to rebuilding it the same as the former world but without the Ash and the Sephira.
records.en: To be more precise, we're to rebuilding it the same as the former world but without the Ash and the Sephira.

records.jp: 私が計画しておいてなんだけど、<CR>本当に“オリジン”なんてものがあるの？
records.en_original: I get the plan, but I still don't understand what Origin actually is.
records.en: I get the plan, but I still don't understand what Origin actually is.

records.jp: 少なくとも、この世には何かを創り出す存在が<CR>あることは確かだよ
records.en_original: Well, we know that there's something in this world that is capable of creation.
records.en: Well, we know that there's something in this world that is capable of creation.

records.jp: 勇希ちゃんがその証明
records.en_original: Yuki is the living proof of that.
records.en: Yuki-chan is the living proof of that.

records.jp: 彼女が再びこの世に生まれたとき、<CR>きっと“オリジン”の力が使われたと思う
records.en_original: It must be Origin's powers that made it possible for her to be reborn into this world.
records.en: It must be Origin's powers that made it possible for her to be reborn into this world.

records.jp: そして、過去のうたちんはその力を使って<CR>無に帰った後の世界を理想の形に創り直そうとした
records.en_original: Also, the old Uta tried to use that power to rebuild the world to her own specifications after it had been reduced to nothingness.
records.en: Uta-chin from the past tried to use that power<CR>to rebuild the world in her ideal form after it returned to nothingness.

records.jp: それをユズたちがやるんだ！
records.en_original: So now we're gonna do the same!
records.en: Yuzu and Lime are going to do it!

records.jp: だから、“オリジン”に正しく想いが届くように、<CR>みんなの想いを一つにしないとね
records.en_original: Now we need to combine all of our emotions so they can be properly conveyed to Origin.
records.en: Now we need to combine all of our emotions so they can be properly conveyed to Origin.

records.jp: さ、他に聞きたいことはある？
records.en_original: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en: Is there anything else you want to ask about?

records.jp: 二人はさ。みんなとの生活、楽しんでる？
records.en_original: Are you two enjoying your life here?
records.en: Are you two enjoying your life here?

records.jp: ん、どうして？
records.en_original: Huh? Why do you ask?
records.en: Huh? Why do you ask?

records.jp: なんだか一歩引いて見てるような気がするから
records.en_original: You two always seem a little detached from the rest of us.
records.en: You two always seem a little detached from the rest of us.

records.jp: 楽しんでるよ？　ご飯もおいしいし！
records.en_original: Of course we're enjoying ourselves! The food here is great!
records.en: Of course we're enjoying ourselves! The food here is great!

records.jp: コモンの番人をしていたときより、<CR>みんなとも話してる気がする
records.en_original: I feel like I get to talk to people more than when I was watching over the Common.
records.en: I feel like I get to talk to people more than when I was watching over the Common.

records.jp: やっぱり二人も、新しい世界で……
records.en_original: When we get to the new world, I hope we—
records.en: When we get to the new world, I hope we—

records.jp: アオちん
records.en_original: Ao-Ao…
records.en: Ao-chin…

records.jp: ……うん、何でもない
records.en_original: ...Right. Forget I said anything.
records.en: ...Right. Forget I said anything.

records.jp: さーて、今日のご飯は何かなー？
records.en_original: Well then, I wonder what's for dinner?
records.en: Well then, I wonder what's for dinner?

records.jp: マシュマロ食べたい
records.en_original: I want to eat marshmallows.
records.en: I want to eat marshmallows.

records.jp: （……新しい世界でも、ちゃんと覚えてろよ、私）
records.en_original: (...I have to remember, even in the new world. I have to.)
records.en: (...I have to remember, even in the new world. I have to.)

records.jp: ……他に聞きたいことはある？
records.en_original: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en: Is there anything else you want to ask about?

records.jp: ううん、大丈夫。<CR>それじゃあ、またね
records.en_original: No, that's all. I'll see you later.
records.en: No, that's all. I'll see you later.
